കൃപാസനം
[സംഗീതം]
പരിശുദ്ധ അമ്മ ജീവനോടെ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ട ഈ
പുണ്യഭൂമിയിൽ ഈ അൾത്താരയിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ട്
സാക്ഷ്യം പറയാനായിട്ട് അനുഗ്രഹിച്ച
അമ്മമാതാവിനും ഈശോക്കും ഒരുപാട് നന്ദി
പറയുന്നു എൻറെ പേര് റീഷ്ണ ഞങ്ങൾ വരുന്നത്

എടുത്തത് 2023 ഓഗസ്റ്റ് 19 ആം തീയതിയാണ്
ഇവിടെ ഇവിടെ കൃപാസനത്തെ കുറിച്ച് അറിയാൻ
ഇടയായത് എന്റെ ഫ്രണ്ടിലൂടെയാണ്.
അവള് ആദ്യമായി സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടിട്ടാണ് ഞങ്ങൾ
ഇവിടെ വന്നത്. ഞങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച്. ഞങ്ങൾ

താമസിച്ചിരുന്നത്. പക്ഷേ കുറച്ചു

താമസിക്കുന്നു കോൺടാക്ട്സ് ഒന്നും
ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നില്ല. എന്നിട്ടും അവൾക്ക്
അമ്മ മാതാവ് ഞങ്ങളെകുറിച്ച് സ്വപ്നം
കാണിച്ചു. അങ്ങനെയാണ് ഇവിടെ വരാൻ സാഹചര്യം
ഉണ്ടായത് ഇത് ഹസ്ബൻഡ്

ഫിനാൻസ് കമ്പനി നടത്തുകയായിരുന്നു

ആത്മഹത്യ ചെയ്യണം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നാടുവിട്ട്
പോകണം എന്നായിരുന്നു

ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടായിരുന്നു.
ആ സമയത്ത് അവൾ വിളിച്ചു പറഞ്ഞു

സ്റ്റേജിൽ ആയിരുന്നു

കാര്യങ്ങൾ

എഴുന്നേറ്റിരിക്കുന്ന അവസ്ഥയായിരുന്നു

നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടു.

ഞങ്ങളെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ വന്നു തുടങ്ങി.

english:
Standing at this altar in this holy land of Kreupasanam where the Blessed Mother appeared alive, blessed to share our testimony,
I give immense thanks to Mother Mary and Jesus. My name is Reeshna, and we come from Bangalore. I first took the Covenant on August 19, 2023.
I came to know about Kreupasanam here through my friend.
We came here after she had a dream about us for the first time. We were friends and used to live nearby. But for a while,
they have been living far away, and we had no contact. Despite that, Mother Mary showed her a dream about us.
That is how the circumstances aligned for us to come here. This is my husband, his name is Shajith, and he was running a finance company there, as a partnership.
After Corona, we faced a lot of hardships. During that difficult time after Corona,
she had the dream and called us. During that period of severe struggle, we felt like we either had to commit suicide or run away from our native place,
that is how we felt. It was a time of intense hardship.
At that time, she called and told us she saw us sitting somewhere far away, and she saw Mother Mary blessing my husband.
After that vision, she is the one who booked the bus tickets for us to come here to take the Covenant.
She gave us all the money to travel and sent us here. That is how I came and took the Covenant for the first time. My husband will share the rest of the details.
A thousand thanks to Mother Mary and the Holy Son. We were at the most critical stage of our lives,
just as my wife said, our family friend saw the mental agony and struggles I was going through exactly in her dream,
and she called us, as she had a strong feeling to check whether we were experiencing such problems or not.
I was in a state where I would wake up at 1 AM or 2 AM, completely shattered financially.
Our savings of 25 years were all lost, due to the financial crisis that followed Corona.
After that, I fell into commitments that I could not possibly settle. I was constantly worrying, about what to do next.
When I thought about my future and what I would do, I couldn't find a single answer.
How would I clear these debts? I owed a lot of money to many people, and I was burdened with liabilities. I had no idea what answers to give them.
It was under those circumstances that our family friend told us about Mother Mary, and how they saw my condition in a dream,
and saw Mother Mary blessing us in their dream. They booked our tickets here, and we arrived,
and first took the Covenant. In the days following our Covenant, changes began to happen in our lives.
Unexpected and miraculous changes started unfolding in our lives.
After that, we participated in the first Rosary service. After the Rosary, I had some amounts pending from Income Tax, and that amount was impossible to receive in any way.
I met the priest for prayers, and the priest blessed me and gave me a blessed medal. Holding onto this blessed medal,
I went to the Income Tax officer and spoke with them. I don't know how, but the approach towards me was unlike how an Income Tax officer would ever treat a customer.
They were so cordial, intervened personally in my matter, and even spoke to the higher authorities from their personal mobile phone.
An amount that was absolutely impossible for me to get was granted to me by the blessing of Mother Mary. I don't know if Mother Mary prompted them,
but they supported me in such an incredible way that I received 90 percent of that amount back.
It was a great blessing and a massive miracle. After that, I lost the interest to carry this financial institution forward.
Until then, 70 percent of the company's responsibilities rested on my shoulders, so I knew my partners would not let me leave.
Nevertheless, I called upon Mother Mary and prayed, expressing that I had no desire to continue running this firm and that my partners should take it over.
This too was a sheer miracle; they agreed, and very soon, legally,
by last November, they completely and legally relieved me from the company.
There are still a few liabilities left, but I can take them on and pay them off. It was Mother Mary who brought me to that level of confidence.
Now I am legally relieved from the company. There are only a few other minor obligations left. I will be able to clear those too.
It is only by the grace of Mother Mary that all of this happened to us. Similarly, our lives have been filled with many small blessings.
We have been saved from several accidents many times. Though I used to have a significant drinking habit,
I have now been completely delivered from alcoholism, and we are leading a happy life.
Even though there are liabilities, the heavy tension, and the immense stress we suffered is now about 90 percent cleared.
As he was legally relieved from the company.
However, he was without a job for about eight months. Now, he is working at a fitness center where the company itself has investments.
I firmly believe that all of this is the blessing of Mother Mary.
Then, as part of apostolic work, the newsletters, we take from here—since we live in Bangalore—we take it to the churches and hospitals there,
and we share our testimony with everyone, explaining how we received Mother's blessings, before distributing it to them.
As I mentioned earlier, many people have refused it and walked away.
Initially, I felt sad about that, but later I became okay with it. Many people have joyfully accepted it, and they even ask for more, to distribute among their friends.
As acts of mercy, in every possible way, both non-financial,
and otherwise, we provide whatever help anyone needs.
There is an old age home nearby; we go there and buy them some food. Besides that, when our children's birthdays arrive,
we prepare some food for them there. We don't have any other grand celebrations at home.
Also, there is another place where food is given to the sick, and we contribute whatever money we can. When birthdays arrive,
or when any special days come in our lives, instead of celebrating, we go to these places and spend our time.
Speaking of today's blessings, we received a great grace today. Usually, we come by train, but,
my daughter is in the tenth standard, and we could only book tickets after receiving her hall ticket. We didn't get train tickets, so we booked a bus.
The bus was very late, delayed by two hours, and we only reached here around 10 o'clock.
Even then we doubted whether we would be able to see the Father and receive his blessings. I prayed continuously while sitting in the bus all along the way.
But fortunately, when we arrived here, although Father wasn't available in the afternoon, right before he left around 1:30 PM at the very last moment, we managed to see him,
and get his blessing for our daughter. I feel that too is a massive grace from Mother Mary. During our difficult times,
when the problem arose with my husband's finance company, we were able to meet Father. Usually, Father says in retreats that since I was the one who took the Covenant, not my husband,
it wouldn't normally work like that. Through a wife's Covenant, usually only those who are severely ill, like cancer patients, get the chance to see Father.
But I don't know what happened that day; I came and submitted a written request, and we received a token from here to meet Father.
That is how my husband was able to meet Father, share all his sorrows, and receive the blessed medal from him. Keeping that medal, he went to see the Income Tax officer.
That is how he got that money back.
Because of Respected Father Joseph, I have grown a lot spiritually. We are Hindus.
So, as I said, it was my friend Liji who prepared the circumstances for me to come here, and she herself brought me a Rosary and a Bible.
At that time, I didn't know how to pray the Rosary, but she taught me, and from then on, I pray the Rosary every day, no matter where I go.
Even if I go out and get late, I only go to sleep after praying the Rosary and reading the Bible.
In case I cannot carry the Bible with me somewhere, I at least read Bible verses on my phone, and through all this, I have grown a lot spiritually.
I have received so many blessings, both small and great, and also many physical healings. To Jesus and Mother Mary, I give crores of thanks.
"He reached down from on high and took hold of me, He drew me out of deep waters."
As Psalm 18:16 says, as a result of coming here and praying, using the blessed medal given by the Reverend Father and the Covenant articles they had in their hands,
whenever they went for any matter, they prayed the Apostles' Creed with faith, and that is how everything moved forward step by step.
The Income Tax officer came almost like Mother Mary herself, explained everything, and helped them get that entire amount back.
He was a person holding 70 percent responsibility in that company, and yet he was completely and legally relieved from it.
They firmly believe that all of this became possible solely because they took the Covenant, and through the prayers of Reverend Father Joseph.
The grace of God they received, and the Covenant life they led by surrendering their intentions with absolute faith,
is what helped them overcome those crises and move forward, and we can understand this in our own lives too.
In situations involving deep waters, meaning circumstances where we feel like we are drowning, let us hold onto our Covenant faith.
We must remember that God is always with us, a God who never abandons us, a God who holds our hands.
It is Mother Mary who teaches us to hold the hand of Jesus and move forward, and in moments when we feel we are drowning,
it is the Blessed Mother who provides the help to hold onto the hands of God.
Let us also surrender each of our circumstances, whatever the situation may be, to God and pray.
When Jesus and Mother Mary stand with us, we can believe that we have a God who reaches down from on high to take hold of us, a God who draws us out of deep waters.
For this special blessing received by Reeshna and her family, let us clap our hands and glorify God; Thank you Jesus, Praise you Jesus, Ave Maria.
